story.title: Kursi Stadion Akhirnya Protes!
story.voice: Aku kursi stadion. Saat pertandingan tegang, kamu berdiri. Begitu gol, malah aku diinjak! Duduk boleh, menginjak jangan!
story.caption: Semua fokus ke pertandingan, kursinya ikut protes 😭 Kamu tim duduk atau berdiri? #Persib #KursiBicara #KomediIndonesia #ZunoLoop
story.visual_prompt: An original expressive anthropomorphic blue stadium seat with eyes and a mouth in a generic football stadium. Coherent 8-second 9:16 cinematic 3D animation. First 2 seconds the chair opens its eyes as fans rise. Seconds 2-5 it bends its legs and dodges a shoe approaching the seat; no injury. Seconds 5-8 the seat sternly gestures toward its cushion then looks at camera annoyed. Rich natural motion, consistent anatomy, no logos, no text, no real athletes, no broadcast footage.

story.title: Tiket Antariksa Tidak Mau Dilipat
story.voice: Aku tiket antariksa, bukan struk belanja! Baru dibeli, sudah dilipat dan hilang di saku. Hei, acaranya di luar!
story.caption: Tiketnya ingin ikut melihat angkasa, bukan terjebak di saku. Planet apa yang ingin kamu lihat? #Antariksa #TiketBicara #AnimasiAI #ZunoLoop
story.visual_prompt: Original anthropomorphic purple paper admission ticket with eyes, mouth and flexible tiny arms, generic space exhibition lobby with planet models. Coherent 8-second 9:16 high quality 3D cartoon animation. 0-2s ticket smiles proudly. 2-5s a hand folds it gently and puts it into a jacket pocket. 5-8s ticket unfolds, climbs halfway out and points toward the planet exhibition while complaining. story.title: This Foam Finger Has One Game-Day Complaint
story.voice: You wave me upside down, then blame me for bad luck? I'm a foam finger! Point me at the game!
story.caption: Game-day excitement has the foam finger protesting. Which way are you waving yours? #GameDay #TalkingObjects #FootballComedy #Shorts
story.visual_prompt: Original anthropomorphic generic orange foam finger with expressive eyes, mouth and flexible foam motion in an American football stadium. Coherent 8-second 9:16 high quality 3D cartoon. 0-2s crowd waves the finger upside down. 2-5s finger notices, reacts angrily and rotates upright. 5-8s it points at the fictional football field then rolls its eyes to camera. story.title: The Telescope Missed the Meteor Shower
story.voice: You brought me outside, then blocked my lens with your thumb? I'm a telescope! Let me see the sky!
story.caption: The telescope was ready. Its owner wasn't. Original fictional stargazing comedy. #SpaceComedy #TalkingObjects #NightSky #Shorts
story.visual_prompt: Original small teal anthropomorphic telescope with expressive eyes and mouth on its tube and intact tripod legs in a backyard at night. Coherent 8-second 9:16 3D animation. 0-2s telescope tilts excitedly toward a fictional starry sky. 2-5s a human thumb accidentally covers its front lens; telescope recoils. 5-8s it pushes the thumb aside with a little arm and looks at camera exasperated. Soft stars, no claim about actual meteor visibility, no logos, no text.
